messages:
Maria G.: Heads up — I'm seeing a spike in lead handoff latency starting ~18:32 UTC. HubSpot -> SF owner assignment is delayed, lots of leads stuck in 'enrichment-pending'. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/leadflow/hand-off?range=1h
leadflow-bot: Alert: inbound-handoff-delay > 4m for 420 leads (threshold 2m). Rule: inbound-routing-sla
Tyler N.: I can repro. queue depth spiked x3 around 18:30. Enrichment service returning 503s intermittently.
Ophelia C.: Sounds like a race between enrichment callback and rr-assignment. If enrichment callback fails we mark lead as 'hold' which blocks round-robin claim.
Jordan: Ran an export of leads with owner=null and created_at < 18:35 — 1187 leads. Pushing sample logs.
Jordan: ```
[18:29:58] POST /webhook/enrich 200 OK lead=00012345
[18:30:02] POST /webhook/enrich 503 Service Unavailable lead=00012346
[18:30:03] POST /webhook/enrich 503 Service Unavailable lead=00012347
[18:30:05] webhook-retry attempt=2 delay=120ms lead=00012346 status=200
```
Tyler N.: Looks like transient 503s from the enrichment worker pool. Our retry backoff is aggressive and ends up leaving leads in 'hold' if the final callback never arrives.
Ophelia C.: Quick mitigation idea: change fallback policy from `hold` -> `yield` for 30m so RR assignment can proceed even if enrichment lags. Minimal risk, lets owners get assigned and CS can re-run enrichment async.
Ana P.: +1 to yield. We should also notify CS about the delayed batch so they can flag VIPs. @Jordan can you add to the incident page?
Jordan: Yep — INC-2026 created and added initial counts + sample lead ids. Also running a dry-run requeue: `./scripts/requeue_leads --filter 'owner:null AND created<"2026-03-23T18:35:00Z"' --dry-run`
Tyler N.: Dry-run shows ~1187 leads. I'll flip the fallback config and monitor. If not stable in 15m we do a full requeue.
leadflow-bot: Job queued: requeue-preview-89711 (1187 leads)
Tyler N.: Config change pushed: `enrichment.timeout_action=yield` (canary rollout 1/3). Watching metrics.
leadflow-bot: Alert: enrichment-5xx-rate increased to 6% over 5m for enrichment-service-canary
Maria G.: Good call on canary. Jordan — once Tyler confirms stability please run the requeue for real. Also let's add an alert for enrichment-callback-5xx > 3% (5m) to page DataOps.
Jordan: Executing real requeue now: `./scripts/requeue_leads --filter 'owner:null AND created<"2026-03-23T18:35:00Z"' --job=89712`
leadflow-bot: Requeue job 89712 started (1187 leads)
Tyler N.: Requeue completing — owners being assigned. Sample success: lead 00012345 owner assigned to SDR-EMEA-06 on attempt 3.
leadflow-bot: Alert cleared: inbound-handoff-delay back to normal (median < 30s)
Maria G.: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Tyler — confirm full rollout and post rollback window (done in #eng-runtime). 2) Jordan — add list of affected leads to the ticket & notify CS. 3) Ana — add enrichment-5xx alert to oncall runbook. 4) Ophelia/Maria — schedule short postmortem if >1h outage.
Tyler N.: Will do. Rolling to 100% now, will update when live.
Jordan: All affected leads requeued and redistributed. INC-2026 updated with sample rows + counts.
leadflow-bot: Incident INC-2026 status -> monitoring
Maria G.: Closing thread here — we'll review in the marketing ops sync tomorrow. :rocket:
